project.name: Car Tuning Sim
project.north_star: Adding the 100th engine should be almost as easy as adding the 2nd.
project.direction: Content scale is a first-class goal: new engines as data entry + validation with zero new C#.

rules: Never branch on engine/part/family identity, cylinder count or layout in src/, calibrators or tune generation.
Physics is code, engines are content; missing features become generic data-driven capabilities.
Reference data is evidence, not a target; never re-fit shared constants or loosen tolerances for one engine.
Parts act only through specifications and interfaces; no percentage bonuses.
Never present estimated or fitted values as published or measured; never invent sources.
Fingerprint baseline changes only by deliberate, approved, reported re-baseline.
Milestones and phases start only when the owner authorizes them; stacking on unmerged PRs needs authorization.
Never merge, close or force-push without explicit authorization.
On a failed gate: stop and investigate; do not weaken tests or tolerances.
Small models gather evidence; they never make architectural, tolerance or physics decisions; escalate instead of guessing.
